name: Card number field with brand detection
note: Formats digits into brand-correct groups (4-4-4-4, Amex 4-6-5, Diners 4-6-4) while preserving the caret, detects the network from the IIN range, and runs a Luhn checksum. Valid state draws the tick; a completed-but-failing number shakes the field. Live region announces the brand and remaining digits.
html: Visa, Mastercard, Amex and Discover accepted.

name: Flip card with security code
note: True 3D flip using preserve-3d and backface-visibility — front carries an embossed chip, gradient laminate and a slow holographic sheen; the back has magstripe, signature panel and the CVC. The button is the accessible control (aria-pressed, label swaps); the card itself is a shortcut click target. Sheen and flip both drop out under reduced motion.

note: Formats the PAN as you type (4-4-4-4, or 4-6-5 for Amex), detects the network from the IIN prefix, and validates with a Luhn checksum. Caret position is preserved through reformatting, so editing mid-number does not jump. State is exposed as data-brand / data-state on the root if you want to hook your own styles in.

name: Flip Card with CVC Reveal II
note: A real 3D flip on a single button element: perspective on the scene, preserve-3d on the inner, backface-visibility on the two faces. The CVC stays blurred until the card is actually facing back, so a screenshot of the front never leaks it. aria-pressed and the label both track the face; reduced motion swaps the rotation for a cut.
